entities.name: Muhammad ibn Iyas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhammad ibn Iyas is one of the most important historians in modern Egyptian history. He was an eyewitness to the Ottoman invasion of Egypt. He was born in Cairo and took his first education there.
